answered.title: How do I restore my identity?
answered.question:
Platform: Mac

I lost my Mac. How do I get my identity back on a new one?
answered.answer:
Open Doughnut Forge on the new Mac, choose Restore Identity and enter your backup phrase.

Your contacts are not part of the backup phrase, so add their contact cards again.

answered.title: Kann ich Ordner verschlüsseln?
answered.question: Geht das auch mit ganzen Ordnern?
answered.answer: Yes. On a Mac or Windows PC, use Secure Directory.

known.title: Face ID asks twice after locking

known.answer: Fixed in the next update. Until then, lock the app, then tap to unlock.
